verdict.rationale: Supabase documents self-hosting the full stack, which includes Auth, on your own computer, server, or cloud infrastructure, with no telemetry. It also states Auth can be used as a standalone product, so the self-managed deployment path is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a private or dedicated managed instance option, documentation on running Auth against your own existing database, and independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosted Auth deployments.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can control where the auth system and its user data run — self-managed deployment, private instance, or my own database

citations.quote: Install and run your own Supabase on your computer, server, or cloud infrastructure.
Self-hosted Supabase **does not phone home or collect any telemetry**.
You can use Supabase Auth as a standalone product, but it's also built to integrate with the Supabase ecosystem.
